# Trompeta de los muertos / Black trumpet

*Craterellus cornucopioides*

Ectomycorrhizal, mostly under beech and oaks, often in moss on moist ground.

**Habitats:** beech, mixed, oak

## Season

Ramps up from 08-15, peak 09-20 to 11-30, ends 12-31. Evidence grade **C**.

GBIF near Tierra Estella, n=40: Jun 2, Aug 1, Sep 7, Oct 17, Nov 8, Dec 4, Jan 1.

### Rationale

- **rain:** Needs persistent moisture; responds to sustained rather than single rains. Values are ours. (field_guides)
- **wet_days:** Several rainy days in the last fortnight keep the litter moist. Values are ours. (field_guides)
- **temperature:** Mild autumn temperatures; the range is ours. (field_guides, gbif_tierra_estella)
- **frost:** Frosts end the season. Counts are ours. (field_guides)
